subject: Nice work...

body:

So good luck with it, and it will be used alot for all me stunt runs, and I'll also use it as a guide to hide in road rage, lol.

And maybe a good guide to find route that people will find hard to follow me. Maybe?

But it could also be a good guide to find the biggest jumps to do flat spins and barrel rolls.

I am impressed, Xan linky to this would be good, in the link section, to show good work thats well done. And help the knoobs find thier way around, lol.

 

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Re: Gates, Billboards and Super Jump locations project
author: Xandu
body:
This is a very good guide. I think most of the smashes and billboards will be the same in the full game. It is a good starting point for a complete guide to smashes, gates and superjumps. Good luck with the work and keep us posted about your progress.

I've promoted this blog to the front page.

-- The Creator --

subject: Thanks
author: evild
body:
Thanks for the comments everyone. I appreciate them.

I'm looking forward to doing the work. I'll detail my process in another blog post.

subject: Re: my wishes for your sanity
author: evild
body:
The video capturing of the individual objectives has to be done by me so there's nothing anyone can do there.

If you'd like, you can download the map from Criterion Games and just start marking stuff off. I could use it to double check and area after I think I've completed it. I'll still have to do all the work of finding everything myself and marking it off on my maps.

I'm not how much that would speed up or slow down the process. I'd just have to experiment and see.

Thanks for your interest!

subject: my wishes for your sanity
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
Dang holy cow man, that looks like alot of work.  So far it looks really good and well organized.  But holy cow thats gonna be alot of work.  I wish you the best of luck with it and hope it works out.  I'm sure it will help alot of people out when you get it all wrapped up.  On a side note, if there was any help people could offer by way of locating things, what would be the easiest way to pass the finds along to you?  Good job by the way, its lookin good.
